nodes.label: External Attacker
nodes.description: Adversary attempting to breach the edge and VR processing network from the outside.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi
nodes.description: Compact Linux-based single-board computer acting as an IoT gateway, sensor hub, or controller.

nodes.label: Exposed SSH / Default Credentials
nodes.description: Misconfigured remote administration interfaces or weak authentication on the Raspberry Pi.

nodes.label: LAN Reconnaissance and Pivoting
nodes.description: Scanning local subnet traffic, ARP poisoning, and discovering co-located edge hardware.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Nano
nodes.description: Embedded GPU-accelerated computing board performing real-time AI and vision inference.

nodes.label: Insecure AI / REST Endpoint Exploitation
nodes.description: Remote code execution or command injection targeting unauthenticated inference endpoints or Docker daemon on the Jetson Nano.

nodes.label: AI Model and Sensor Manipulation
nodes.description: Modification of local inference weights, pipeline data poisoning, or camera feed spoofing.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop Workstation
nodes.description: Host PC running the Oculus runtime, driver stack, and VR rendering applications.

nodes.label: Oculus AirLink / LAN Protocol Abuse
nodes.description: Exploiting local network VR streaming services, client-server handshake weaknesses, or remote desktop services.

nodes.label: VR Telemetry and Audio/Video Capture
nodes.description: Interception and exfiltration of head-tracking telemetry, spatial mapping data, and headset camera streams.

nodes.label: Rootkit and Firmware Persistence
nodes.description: Flash memory modifications, persistent systemd services, or malicious crontabs across compromised nodes.
